## Automated Tests Required
For relevant criteria record Given/When/Then, boundary/failure cases, actual
production interface, selected test location/runner, expected report and failure
behavior. Do not invent a production class or substitute an unrelated smoke test.
Distinguish necessary test infrastructure from tests this work will create.

## Manual QA Checklist
For each applicable criterion state setup, action, observation, decision basis,
evidence location and qualified evaluator. Use human judgment where needed in any
story type. Screenshots establish only what they show; runtime/experience needs
the actual activity. Reference selected accessibility/input/platform commitments.
